palette_rationale: Preserve the reviewed turquoise body, red horns and wings, cream chest, and source dark red/black eyes. The eyes already separate from the face in native Idle; no added facial pixels.
reference: Own DSTS chr208 model and native clips; PMDO registry supplies action names, events, and timing fields.

actions.name: Walk
actions.pose_evidence: Native leg cycle; exclude duplicate endpoint.

actions.name: Attack
actions.pose_evidence: Native forward lunge and claw strike; auditioned the windup and contact.

actions.name: Shoot
actions.pose_evidence: Native open-mouth face release; no projectile asset.

actions.name: Sleep
actions.pose_evidence: Native crouched resting motion; source eyes appear open at auditioned front and side poses.

actions.name: Hurt
actions.pose_evidence: Native ordinary recoil; more extreme bd02/bd03 remain unused.

actions.name: Swing
actions.pose_evidence: Native broad body and wing/claw sweep; no weapon added.

actions.name: Double
actions.pose_evidence: Two native strike cycles; PMDO XML exposes one HitFrame.

actions.name: Hop
actions.pose_evidence: Native whole-body lift with foot separation visible in front and side auditions.

actions.name: Charge
actions.pose_evidence: Native braced hands, head and mouth expression, reverse-sampled to recover. The bv01 source clip moves off canvas early and late and was rejected; no invented effect.

actions.name: Rotate
actions.pose_evidence: Native gaze/face motion with whole-view yaw for engine Rotate; exclude duplicate endpoint.
